title: The Fallen Heart Flame Breaks Free
summary: The Fallen Heart Flame rises from the Blazing Qi Refining Tower in the shape of a huge fire python, and Zi Yan says it has no Magical Beast aura. Yao Lao tells Xiao Yan he can't capture it in his current state, so they hide and watch. Su Qian and the Inner Academy elders cast the Thousand Layers Formation and an energy net to hold the flame. Han Feng enters the academy with the Black-Corner Region leaders, and his men take on the academy's Enforcer Squad. The Outer Academy's vice dean and elders arrive to hold the net, and while the flame rests, Su Qian leads the Inner Academy elders in a sealing formation that forces it back. Yao Lao senses another force coming, and Han Feng appears at the tower and greets Su Qian.
events: Students flee the tower as the flame bursts out.
The Fallen Heart Flame takes a python-like beast form; Zi Yan says it has no Magical Beast aura.
Yao Lao keeps Xiao Yan back to watch.
The elders cast the Thousand Layers Formation; Rock Gate members head to the tower.
Han Feng's group enters the academy and meets the Enforcer Squad.
The Outer Academy's vice dean and elders arrive and join the energy net.
Su Qian's elders seal the flame back in while it rests.
Han Feng appears at the tower and greets Su Qian.
